records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: •Net sales for the three months ended March 31, 2023 increased by 49% to $548.3 million compared to $367.0 million for the same period in 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: For example, module spot pricing in the United States has increased primarily due to the rising demand for modules manufactured in the United States as a result of the IRA and, in part, due to elevated commodity and logistics costs.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: •Gross profit for the three months ended March 31, 2023 increased 17.3 percentage points to 20.4% from 3.1% for the same period in 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: In recent years, the cost of producing electricity from PV solar power systems has decreased to levels that are competitive with or below the wholesale price of electricity in many markets.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in net cash used in operating activities was primarily driven by higher expenditures for the construction of certain projects in Japan in the prior period and higher cash receipts from module sales in the current period, including advance payments for future sales, partially offset by certain advance payments for raw materials in the current period.
